examples.worked_solution:
The formula for ${}_nP_r$ is given by

$$
{}_nP_r  = \dfrac {n!} {(n - r)!} \,.
$$

Substituting $n={11}$ and $r=2$ into the above, we get

$$
\require{cancel}
        \eqalign{
        	
        	{}_{11}P_2  &= \dfrac {11!} {(11 - 2)!} \[5pt]
                            &= \dfrac {11!}{9!} \[5pt]
                            &= \dfrac {11 \cdot 10 \cdot  \cancel{9!}} {\cancel{9!}} \[5pt]
                            &= 11 \cdot 10 \[5pt]
                            &= 110.
         }
$$
